subject: incident-local stable-ID append and export boundary
source_of_truth: Authored records.jsonl is the incident-local observation history only; owner authority and normal outbox/sync remain in Sprintctl
initial_state: empty private incident namespace or valid authored prior history
no service endpoint, credential or owner state

operations.name: append stable-ID record or retry exact authored payload
operations.synchronization: flock exclusive around history scan and fsynced append

consistency.object: one incident-local append-only file with stable authored record identity

assumptions.isolation: cooperating processes using flock; current-user regular singly linked file; no hostile same-user inode replacement
assumptions.clock: created_at authored by caller and retained across exact retries; no lease or authority clock
assumptions.fairness: no availability guarantee after corrupt/incomplete history; preserve and inspect

invariants: exact same-ID authored retry adds no row
changed payload under existing ID refuses without changing authored bytes
incomplete/corrupt/foreign/duplicate-ID history remains unchanged and cannot append/export
only current-user private regular singly linked store accepted
export cannot submit, apply, settle or create a generic outbox
faults: process exit after fsync before reply
JSON type drift and invalid authored JSON
oracles: vuoro.client.tests: history bytes unchanged on retry/refusal and exactly one row for concurrent retry
vuoro.boundaries: client wheel remains transport-only with no domain adapter, driver, authority or migration
